plan.title: Support task ID slugs
plan.overview: Extend the ID generation system to produce slug-based IDs (e.g., 021-support-task-id-slugs) instead of plain numeric IDs. Uses the slugify npm package for URL-safe slug generation. Task lookup scripts must extract the numeric portion using /^(\d+)/ regex to support both legacy numeric folders (001-020) and new slug-based folders.

approach.rationale:
Following existing patterns: - CLI Script Flow: parse args -> read config -> process -> output JSON (systems/cli/_index.md:120-170) - Tagged Union Errors: { success: true, data } or { error: true, message } (patterns/tagged-union-errors.md:34-49) - Numeric Prefix Parsing: /^(\d+)/ regex pattern (apps/festinalente/src/scripts/select-context.ts:78)
Key design decisions: - Slugify with strict mode and lowercase to ensure filesystem-safe slugs - MAX_SLUG_LENGTH = 50 hardcoded constant (no config overhead) - Numeric prefix ensures uniqueness even if titles truncate to same 50-char slug - No migration of existing tasks (001-020 remain numeric)
